title: Resistance: Fall of Man (Resistance: Fall of Man: native PC port)
description: Native PC port of Resistance: Fall of Man (PS3) via static recompilation. D3D12 renderer, NVIDIA DLSS/DLAA and FSR upscaling, 60 fps, in-game PC menu, ultrawide, raw mouse input, keyboard and Xbox prompts. Requires your own copy of the game.
